name: B-1B Lancer
summary: Long-range supersonic swing-wing bomber, flown by Air Force Global Strike Command as a conventional heavy bomber.

wings: Variable-sweep (swing) wings: spread wide at low speed, swept back against the body when fast
Wings blend into the fuselage through broad, smooth wing-glove fairings
engines: Four engines in two paired nacelles beneath the wing roots
Rectangular intakes at the front of each paired nacelle
fuselage: Long, slender blended fuselage with a pointed nose
Small vanes (fins) on each side of the nose just behind the radome
tail: Single large swept vertical fin with a long dorsal fillet
All-moving horizontal tails mounted at the base of the fin, above the exhausts

tellTales: Long slender bomber whose wings sweep back when fast and spread out when slow
Engines grouped in two paired nacelles under the blended wing roots
Small vanes on the nose behind the radome

confusedWith.howToTell: The B-1B is sleek and blended with swing wings and paired engines under the body; the B-52 has fixed high wings with eight engines in four pods.
The B-1B has a long fuselage and a tall fin; the B-2 is a tailless flying wing.
